recommendation: Keep the source change as-is. It reapplies the accepted clarification to the current build-scoped resource without changing conformance behavior; no separate source change is needed for the rename or warning issues in this commit.
issue_request: FHIR-31852 was a Published/Persuasive BRR clarification request for the R4 ClinicalUseIssue resource asking the specification to explain why the resource combined multiple independent concepts; the accepted resolution was to add rationale explaining why the concepts were not separate and what they have in common.
initial_application: Jira records that the change was applied on 2022-02-02. Git history contains e7c61bc392e7f5f27c18dd3986aa7fabf193e080, 'added explanation re FHIR#31852', which added the requested Scope and Usage rationale and changed a residual 'clinical issue' reference to 'clinical use'. That commit is visible in history but is not an ancestor of the current worker HEAD, and the current active ClinicalUseDefinition introduction did not contain the rationale.
additional_context: FHIR-31847 renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition before R5, so the current build-scope artifact is source/clinicalusedefinition rather than the retired source/clinicaluseissue path. source/fhir.ini actively lists ClinicalUseDefinition and comments out ClinicalUseIssue. Later ClinicalUseDefinition scope changes, including warning support, mean the restored wording needs to fit the current list of indication, contraindication, interaction, undesirable effect, and warning.
reconciliation: Restored a concise rationale paragraph in the active ClinicalUseDefinition introduction explaining the common use contexts and the cross-workgroup decision to combine separate resources into one typed resource instance. Also restored the directly related terminology correction from 'clinical issue' to 'clinical use' so the narrative matches the renamed resource.
source_changes: source/clinicalusedefinition/clinicalusedefinition-introduction.xml: changed a stale 'clinical issue' reference to 'clinical use' and restored a rationale paragraph explaining common contexts and the cross-workgroup decision to combine separate resources into one typed resource instance.

related_jiras.note: Renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition, establishing the current source path for the FHIR-31852 clarification.
Added warning support to the same resource family, so the restored rationale was aligned with the current type list.
